ModMetaData.name: Authoritative Server Probe (Experimental)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Authoritative Multiplayer Server contributors
ModMetaData.description: Experimental developer-only local authoritative simulation probe. NOT a playable multiplayer mod or dedicated server. Single loaded map only. Requires a separate test mod profile and an explicit Start click in mod settings. Do not enable alongside rwmt.Multiplayer. Do not expose the loopback TCP port.
